item.title: Heber City swears in mayor, city councilors, police officers
item.description: The Heber City Council chambers were more packed than usual on Tuesday as friends and family members squeezed in for the swearings-in of Mayor Heidi Franco and city councilors Yvonne Barney and Morgan Murdock, who were elected in November. item.title: Here’s who filed for elected office in Wasatch County
item.description: The filing period for declarations of candidacy in the 2026 general election has closed for Wasatch County. Candidates filed for positions on the county level including Wasatch County clerk-auditor, Wasatch County Council seats A, C and F, Wasatch County Sheriff and Wasatch County School District board seats C and D. The post Here’s who filed for elected office in Wasatch County appeared first on Park Record.
